# A USD bill posted to a USD expense account, with no payment yet.
#
# The bill, its payable and its expense account are all USD, so no currency
# difference stands in the way of linking a transaction to it. That is what
# makes it the book for asking whether the bill's own posting transaction can
# be applied as its payment.
#
# What this fixture produces: `Expenses:Supplies:USD` at 100.00 and
# `Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD` at -100.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Due From Director USD
  type: Asset
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

bill "BILL-SELF-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-12
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-12
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-12
    due: 2026-04-12
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-SELF-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment: none
